value.hook: Open before reviewing Copilot hook/tool wiring or upgrading the bundled SDK.
value.title: Verify the active Copilot SDK registration contract

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Inspect the active extracted runtime's bundled copilot-sdk implementation and declarations, not just the npm wrapper: their versions can differ. On #250 at 84ca653e3c101153e06b890a8ee2ffb512eac5c7, CLI 1.0.114 consumed tools.definitions and hooks.handlers; flat fields silently registered nothing. Cached 1.0.113 agreed, while 1.0.112 required flat fields. The documented minimum is >=1.0.113, with no legacy fallback; recheck this contract on upgrades rather than treating these versions as current forever.

session.on subscriptions are separate from configurable hooks: preserve session.idle and wildcard observers outside hooks.handlers. The handwritten test resolver substitutes the SDK, so green tests defend today's copied shape, not future upstream drift. A supported-real-SDK registration canary remains the highest-value non-blocking proof improvement.

FYI sender/time attribution and indentation are not sanitization or proof of prompt-injection resistance. #250 restored unchanged handlers, not a new body-to-authority path. Exact-head security verdict: a97022967bb5c54c2e1ed012180e8375e351aeda.
